notes: Scope is borderline: the packet never frames its data as time series; the time-indexed inputs are traffic counts and simulated travel-time metrics. Card drift: 'Planning and Workflow' is a retired label and is replaced. No LLM-side module, because the agents use off-the-shelf GPT-3.5, GPT-4 and Llama without training. No GTS module, because no temporal function is implemented as a separate mechanism. The tool pool is traffic-specific in its tool semantics but is kept at GH because its execution loop carries no task objective. Travel-time and throughput under TSC are recorded as task_performance; decision_utility is left false, which a reviewer could contest.
